rules.name: unnecessary-generator-dict
rules.summary: Unnecessary generator (rewrite as a dict comprehension)

rules.name: unnecessary-list-comprehension-set
rules.summary: Unnecessary list comprehension (rewrite as a set comprehension)

rules.name: unnecessary-list-comprehension-dict
rules.summary: Unnecessary list comprehension (rewrite as a dict comprehension)

rules.name: unnecessary-literal-set
rules.summary: Unnecessary {kind} literal (rewrite as a set literal)

rules.name: unnecessary-literal-dict
rules.summary: Unnecessary {obj_type} literal (rewrite as a dict literal)

rules.name: unnecessary-literal-within-tuple-call
rules.summary: Unnecessary list literal passed to `tuple()` (rewrite as a tuple literal)

rules.name: unnecessary-literal-within-list-call
rules.summary: Unnecessary list literal passed to `list()` (remove the outer call to `list()`)

rules.name: unnecessary-list-call
rules.summary: Unnecessary `list()` call (remove the outer call to `list()`)

rules.name: unnecessary-subscript-reversal
rules.summary: Unnecessary subscript reversal of iterable within `{func}()`

rules.name: unnecessary-literal-within-dict-call
rules.summary: Unnecessary dict {kind} passed to `dict()` (remove the outer call to `dict()`)

rules.name: unnecessary-dict-comprehension-for-iterable
rules.summary: Unnecessary dict comprehension for iterable; use `dict.fromkeys` instead

rules.name: unused-import
rules.summary: `{name}` imported but unused; consider using `importlib.util.find_spec` to test for availability

rules.name: for-loop-writes
rules.summary: Use of `{}.write` in a for loop

rules.name: readlines-in-for
rules.summary: Instead of calling `readlines()`, iterate over file object directly

rules.name: fromisoformat-replace-z
rules.summary: Unnecessary timezone replacement with zero offset

rules.name: redundant-log-base
rules.summary: Prefer `math.{log_function}({arg})` over `math.log` with a redundant base

rules.name: int-on-sliced-str
rules.summary: Use of `int` with explicit `base={base}` after removing prefix

rules.name: isinstance-type-none
rules.summary: Prefer `is` operator over `isinstance` to check if an object is `None`

rules.name: type-none-comparison
rules.summary: When checking against `None`, use `{}` instead of comparison with `type(None)`

rules.name: list-reverse-copy
rules.summary: Use of assignment of `reversed` on list `{name}`

rules.name: slice-to-remove-prefix-or-suffix
rules.summary: Prefer `str.removeprefix()` over conditionally replacing with slice.

rules.name: sorted-min-max
rules.summary: Prefer `min` over `sorted()` to compute the minimum value in a sequence

rules.name: unnecessary-list-cast
rules.summary: Do not cast an iterable to `list` before iterating over it

rules.name: incorrect-dict-iterator
rules.summary: When using only the {subset} of a dict use the `{subset}()` method

rules.name: try-except-in-loop
rules.summary: `try`-`except` within a loop incurs performance overhead

rules.name: manual-list-comprehension
rules.summary: Use {message_str} to create a transformed list

rules.name: manual-list-copy
rules.summary: Use `list` or `list.copy` to create a copy of a list

rules.name: manual-dict-comprehension
rules.summary: Use a dictionary comprehension instead of {modifier} for-loop

rules.name: duplicate-class-field-definition
rules.summary: Class field `{name}` is defined multiple times

rules.name: os-path-join
rules.summary: `os.{module}.join()` should be replaced by `Path` with `/` operator

rules.name: py-path
rules.summary: `py.path` is in maintenance mode, use `pathlib` instead

rules.name: path-constructor-current-directory
rules.summary: Do not pass the current directory explicitly to `Path`

rules.name: duplicate-isinstance-call
rules.summary: Multiple `isinstance` calls for `{name}`, merge into a single call

rules.name: collapsible-if
rules.summary: Use a single `if` statement instead of nested `if` statements

rules.name: compare-with-tuple
rules.summary: Use `{replacement}` instead of multiple equality comparisons

rules.name: uncapitalized-environment-variables
rules.summary: Use capitalized environment variable `{expected}` instead of `{actual}`

rules.name: enumerate-for-loop
rules.summary: Use `enumerate()` for index variable `{index}` in `for` loop

rules.name: open-file-with-context-handler
rules.summary: Use a context manager for opening files

rules.name: if-else-block-instead-of-dict-lookup
rules.summary: Use a dictionary instead of consecutive `if` statements

rules.name: multiple-with-statements
rules.summary: Use a single `with` statement with multiple contexts instead of nested `with` statements

rules.name: if-expr-with-false-true
rules.summary: Use `not ...` instead of `False if ... else True`

rules.name: if-expr-with-twisted-arms
rules.summary: Use `{expr_else} if {expr_else} else {expr_body}` instead of `{expr_body} if not {expr_else} else {expr_else}`

rules.name: split-static-string
rules.summary: Consider using a list literal instead of `str.{}`

rules.name: non-pep585-annotation
rules.summary: Use `{to}` instead of `{from}` for type annotation

rules.name: unnecessary-future-import
rules.summary: Unnecessary `__future__` import `{import}` for target Python version

rules.name: convert-typed-dict-functional-to-class
rules.summary: Convert `{name}` from `TypedDict` functional to class syntax

rules.name: convert-named-tuple-functional-to-class
rules.summary: Convert `{name}` from `NamedTuple` functional to class syntax

rules.name: unpacked-list-comprehension
rules.summary: Replace unpacked list comprehension with a generator expression

rules.name: format-literals
rules.summary: Use implicit references for positional format fields

rules.name: printf-string-formatting
rules.summary: Use format specifiers instead of percent format

rules.name: outdated-version-block
rules.summary: Version block is outdated for minimum Python version

rules.name: non-pep604-isinstance
rules.summary: Use `X | Y` in `{}` call instead of `(X, Y)`

rules.name: non-pep695-type-alias
rules.summary: Type alias `{name}` uses {type_alias_method} instead of the `type` keyword

rules.name: non-pep695-generic-class
rules.summary: Generic class `{name}` uses `Generic` subclass instead of type parameters

rules.name: non-pep695-generic-function
rules.summary: Generic function `{name}` should use type parameters
